evidence: The Cass River end of the track starts from the signposted car park at the east end of the Cass road bridge, opposite Cass settlement.
The track descends through beech and exotic forest to Bealey Hut (six bunks).
A further 5 minute walk from the hut takes you to the car park by Cora Lynn Station, and another 2 minutes to SH73.

doubts: The main start is the signposted car park at the east end of the Cass road bridge, which is not a road-end feature, so the start ref is null. F2 (unnamed track meeting West Coast Road) is recorded as the SH73 track start, which the text reaches by walking 1 km from the Cass settlement car park rather than being the car park itself. The end is taken as F1 (unnamed track meeting Cora Lynn Road) for the car park by Cora Lynn Station. The Cass River is not a clearly unbridged ford: the text says to cross it several times but also notes a bridged crossing, so no ford tag. Lagoon Saddle Shelter is not counted as a hut as the text gives no bunks for it. The riverbed Hamilton-West Harper alternative and the reverse walk from Cora Lynn Road are not separate ways (no heading, time or distance; the reverse is the same route). The DOC distance is blank, so distance is null.
